arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys, json, subprocess, os
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
from pathlib import Path
from _tree import freeze_tree, temporary_tree
from bootstrap import install
cases=json.load(open('/workspace/examples/fixtures.json'))
with temporary_tree(prefix='pc2-', dir='/workspace/tmp') as run:
    freeze_tree(Path('/workspace/submission'), Path(run)/'submission')
    install(Path('/workspace/wheels'), Path(run)/'deps')
    for case in cases:
        env={'PATH':'/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin','HOME':'/workspace','LANG':'C','LC_ALL':'C',
             'TMPDIR':run,'PYTHONHASHSEED':'0','PYTHONUNBUFFERED':'1'}
        raw=json.dumps(case['input']).encode()
        p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(Path(run)/'submission/campaign.py')],
                         input=raw, capture_output=True, cwd=run, env=env)
        print(case['name'], 'rc', p.returncode, 'stderr', p.stderr.decode()[:200])
        a=json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
        print('  match', a==case['expected'])
EOF
